name: waykit
description: Waykit: software lifecycle, skills, and learning loops for coding agents

scripts.test: node --import tsx/esm --test 'kit/src/**/*.test.ts' mcps/servers/kit-knowledge/src/knowledge.test.ts mcps/servers/memory/src/memory.test.ts && pnpm --dir web test
scripts.test:ci: mkdir -p out/reports && node --import tsx/esm --test --test-reporter=spec --test-reporter=./kit/src/test-report/github_test_reporter.mjs --test-reporter-destination=stdout --test-reporter-destination=out/reports/unit-test-report.md 'kit/src/**/*.test.ts' mcps/servers/kit-knowledge/src/knowledge.test.ts mcps/servers/memory/src/memory.test.ts && pnpm --dir web test
